{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :-
1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC.
2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm.
3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT.
4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is marked '---' while note N3 specifies case hardening to 56–60 HRC with a 0.8–1.2 mm case depth, creating a contradiction that could cause the part to be shipped without heat treatment. The designer should update the title block heat treatment field to reference note N3 or state the required treatment directly.","recommended_correction":"Change the title block heat_treatment field from '---' to a value consistent with note N3 (e.g., 'CASE HARDENED PER N3')."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D14","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 50 H7 +0.025"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D7","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 8 H7"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D23","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 6 H7"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"MATERIAL: 20mNcR5
FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)
MACHINING:
WEIGHT(Kg ): 2.15 kg"}],"comment":"Dimensions D14 (⌀ 50 H7), D7 (⌀ 8 H7), and D23 (⌀ 6 H7) are tight ISO-fit holes on a part that receives an I.Z.B.P. (trivalent zinc) plating per note N4, yet no allowance for plating thickness is specified. Plating buildup inside these holes will reduce their diameters and prevent mating parts from fitting. The designer should add notes specifying that these holes must be masked during plating, reamed after plating, or that the pre-plate dimensions must be adjusted to account for coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note indicating that holes D14, D7, and D23 are to be masked during plating or machined to pre-plate limits that accommodate the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
